**Customer Summary:**
Customer inquired about Leafy Plus membership ($59/year, free shipping/returns, 90-day guarantee, 10% accessories discount, early rare plant access). Clarified express shipping excluded, promos don't combine with member pricing, 14-day refund window if unused. Customer asked about guarantee on pre-membership purchases. Explained: 90-day guarantee applies only to plants ordered while membership active; pre-membership plants covered by standard 30-day guarantee from delivery.
